messages.content: What are the calories of a Big Mac?

message.content:
A standard **McDonald’s Big Mac** contains roughly **≈ 550 kcal** (about 580 kJ) per sandwich.  

| Item | Calories |
|------|----------|
| Standard Big Mac (US) | ~550 kcal |

> *This figure comes from McDonald’s U.S. nutrition facts sheet (as of 2025). Calorie counts may vary slightly depending on regional recipes or ingredient changes.*
